name: Cute Login Logo – Upload Your Own Custom Logo for Branding in the Login Page
author: Sadhan Pal

sections.description:
Login Login Logo allows you to personalize your WordPress login page by replacing the default WordPress logo with your own custom image.
With a simple interface and live preview, you can brand the login page to match your website or business identity.

Features:
* Upload a custom login logo directly from the WordPress media library.
* Set logo width and height with min/max dimension validation.
* Preview the logo before saving.
* Clear/reset the logo with a single click.
* Lightweight and easy to use.

This plugin is perfect for agencies, freelancers, and site owners who want to add a professional touch to their client or business sites.

License

This plugin is open-source and licensed under the GPLv2 or later.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/cute-login-logo/ directory, or install via the WordPress plugin installer.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Go to Settings → Login Logo to upload and configure your custom login logo.
sections.faq:
What is the recommended size for the logo?

We recommend a maximum width of 320px and height of 200px for best display results.

Can I reset or remove the logo?

Yes, simply click the Clear Logo button in the settings.

Does this plugin affect my site performance?

No, it is lightweight and only modifies the login page.
